title: If You’re a Sincere Conservative on the Gay Issue …
excerpt: I’m sure you agree we need a better, more sane and charitable debate. You couldn’t ask for a more sane and charitable participant in that debate than Justin Lee. That’s why I’m such a big fan of his blog and his new book.
